anatomy.item1: Raiz — role="progressbar" com a família aria-value*, que recebe o valor.
anatomy.item2: Trilha — a caixa por onde o indicador corre. Quando a raiz é a própria trilha, não há peça separada.
anatomy.item3: Indicador — a parte cheia, que reflete o valor atual.
anatomy.item4: Rótulo — opcional. Onde a biblioteca oferece a peça, ele nomeia a barra; senão é texto ao lado, e o nome vai em aria-label.
anatomy.item5: Valor — número opcional (ex: 42%), alinhado à direita e oculto do leitor de tela, que já ouve o valor pela raiz.

structureCode.angular: Enviando arquivo

  :model-value="42"              <!-- null ativa o modo indeterminado -->
  :max="100"
  aria-label="Enviando arquivo"  <!-- o nome vem daqui: não há slot de rótulo -->
/>

guidelines.title: Guidelines Obrigatórias
guidelines.item1: Use para operações com 3+ segundos onde o progresso é mensurável.
guidelines.item2: Para duração desconhecida, passe null ou omita o valor — as duas formas dão o modo indeterminado.
guidelines.item3: Sempre dê nome acessível à barra, descrevendo o que está sendo medido: aria-label, ou o rótulo associado onde a biblioteca oferece a peça.
guidelines.item4: Anuncie a porcentagem via aria-live="polite" no texto adjacente.

item4.a: Skeleton, se a estrutura do conteúdo for conhecida

extensibilityCode.vue:
<!-- Cor semântica da barra -->
<Progress :model-value="progress" data-variant="success" aria-label="Sincronização" />

<!-- Texto anunciado no lugar do percentual -->
<Progress
  :model-value="42"
  aria-label="Processamento de arquivos"
  :get-value-text="(value, max) => value === null ? 'Contando arquivos' : `${value} de ${max} arquivos`"
/>

  aria-label="Processamento de arquivos"
  getAriaValueText={(value, min, max) =>

/>

notes.item1: Comportamento e visual em camadas separadas — o papel progressbar, os valores mínimo, máximo e atual anunciados ao leitor de tela e a conversão do valor em proporção preenchida vêm da camada de comportamento; o design system entrega a camada visual, nas classes .nds-progress-*. Trocar a camada de comportamento não muda o desenho.
notes.item2: Indeterminate — sem valor, a raiz perde aria-valuenow e ganha data-indeterminate. É desse atributo que o CSS compartilhado tira a largura do traço e a animação; não há classe de animação para aplicar.
notes.item3: Cor da barra — data-variant="success" e data-variant="destructive" são as variantes medidas. Para outra cor, defina --nds-progress-color na instância e confira o contraste de 3:1 contra a trilha.
notes.item4: Não interativo — Progress é passivo. Para rastrear conclusão, dispare evento no callback da operação, não no componente.

en.title: Progress
en.description: Visual indicator of progress for measurable operations, with support for determinate and indeterminate modes.

seo.title: Progress — Feedback
seo.description: Progress: bar with role="progressbar", determinate and indeterminate modes, value clamped to range, announced text and 3:1 contrast against the track.
seo.aiSummary: Progress component: passive bar with role="progressbar", aria-valuemin and aria-valuemax always present, aria-valuenow only with a value and aria-valuetext with the percentage or "Em andamento". A missing or null value turns on indeterminate mode; out of range, it is clamped. Success and destructive variants change only the bar colour.
seo.aiEntities: Progress, React, Vue, Svelte, Vanilla, Angular, WCAG 2.2, role progressbar

anatomy.item1: Root — role="progressbar" with the aria-value* family, receiving the value.
anatomy.item2: Track — the box the indicator runs along. When the root is the track itself, there is no separate piece.
anatomy.item3: Indicator — the filled part, reflecting the current value.
anatomy.item4: Label — optional. Where the library provides the piece, it names the bar; otherwise it is text beside it, and the name goes in aria-label.
anatomy.item5: Value — optional number (e.g. 42%), right-aligned and hidden from screen readers, which already hear the value from the root.

guidelines.title: Required Guidelines
guidelines.item1: Use for operations of 3+ seconds where progress is measurable.
guidelines.item2: For unknown duration, pass null or omit the value — both give indeterminate mode.
guidelines.item3: Always give the bar an accessible name describing what is being measured: aria-label, or the associated label where the library provides the piece.
guidelines.item4: Announce percentage via aria-live="polite" on adjacent text.

item4.a: Skeleton, if the content structure is known

label.name: Label
label.format: Gerund + object · no period · max 5 words

do.title: Use when
do.item1: There is a 3+ second operation with measurable duration
do.item2: The user needs to know how much is left to finish
do.item3: A long task can be paused or canceled

dont.title: Do not use when
dont.item3: Progress cannot be measured — use indeterminate mode, never an invented value
dont.item4: It's just an end notification — use Sonner or Alert

pair1.do: Provide aria-label describing the measured operation.
pair1.dont: Don't use generic aria-label like "Bar" or "Progress".

pair2.do: Combine visible percentage with aria-live polite on the text.
pair2.dont: Do not use aria-live assertive on the value — it interrupts the reader on every update.

styles.withLabel: Label and value above the track — their own pieces where the library provides them, text beside it when not.
styles.semantic: data-variant switches the bar colour to success or destructive; the track stays neutral so contrast never depends on the choice.

default.label: Default
default.behavior: Initial state — value at the minimum, empty indicator and the zero ANNOUNCED, which is what separates it from indeterminate.

loading.label: Loading
loading.behavior: In progress — indicator filled in proportion to the value within the range.

complete.label: Complete
complete.behavior: Finished — value equal to the maximum, full bar. Consider removing it or replacing it with a success message.

indeterminate.label: Indeterminate
indeterminate.behavior: No value — aria-valuenow absent, announced text "Em andamento" and a short dash running along the track in a loop.

value.description: Current value, between minimum and maximum. null or missing turns on indeterminate mode; out of range, it is clamped before being announced and drawn.

getAriaValueText.description: Text announced instead of the number. By default, the percentage — or "Em andamento" without a value.

className.description: Additional .nds-* classes. The bar colour is not switched by class — use the variant property.

variant.description: Semantic colour of the bar. When absent, the bar uses the primary colour.

ariaLabel.description: Accessible name of the bar — describes the measured operation.

  :get-value-text="(value, max) => value === null ? 'Counting files' : `${value} of ${max} files`"
/>

aria.valuetext: aria-valuetext announces the percentage ("42%"), or "Em andamento" without a value

notes.item1: Behaviour and looks in separate layers — the progressbar role, the min, max and current values announced to the screen reader, and turning the value into a filled proportion come from the behaviour layer; the design system ships the visual layer, in the .nds-progress-* classes. Swapping the behaviour layer does not change the design.
notes.item2: Indeterminate — with no value the root loses aria-valuenow and gains data-indeterminate. The shared CSS derives the sweep width and the animation from that attribute; there is no animation class to apply.
notes.item3: Bar colour — data-variant="success" and data-variant="destructive" are the measured variants. For any other colour, set --nds-progress-color on the instance and check the 3:1 contrast against the track.
notes.item4: Non-interactive — Progress is passive. To track completion, fire the event on the operation callback, not on the component.

analytics.description: Relevant events (fired by the application, not by Progress).

functional.description: What should happen in response to each value change.

item6.result: Indeterminate mode, same as passing null

item7.result: The indeterminate dash stops at the start of the track

notes.item1: Comportamiento y visual en capas separadas — el rol progressbar, los valores mínimo, máximo y actual anunciados al lector de pantalla y la conversión del valor en proporción llenada vienen de la capa de comportamiento; el design system entrega la capa visual, en las clases .nds-progress-*. Cambiar la capa de comportamiento no cambia el diseño.
notes.item2: Indeterminate — sin valor, la raíz pierde aria-valuenow y gana data-indeterminate. De ese atributo el CSS compartido saca el ancho del trazo y la animación; no hay clase de animación que aplicar.
notes.item3: Color de la barra — data-variant="success" y data-variant="destructive" son las variantes medidas. Para otro color, define --nds-progress-color en la instancia y verifica el contraste de 3:1 contra la pista.
notes.item4: No interactivo — Progress es pasivo. Para rastrear finalización, dispara el evento en el callback de la operación, no en el componente.

analytics.description: Eventos relevantes (disparados por la aplicación, no por Progress).

functional.title: Comportamiento Funcional

item2.result: El indicador llena la mitad de la pista

item5.action: Pasar un valor fuera de rango

item6.result: Modo indeterminado, igual que pasar null

item7.result: El trazo indeterminado se detiene al inicio de la pista

accessibility.item2: Contraste mínimo 3:1 entre indicador y pista

accessibility.item5: Nombre accesible en cada ejemplo — aria-label, o la etiqueta asociada cuando existe
accessibility.item6: aria-valuetext anuncia el porcentaje, o "Em andamento" sin valor
